screenSummary.playArea: A slope field for a first-order differential equation, with the solution through the initial point and optional exact curve, equilibria, and isocline.
screenSummary.controlArea: Choose an equation, toggle exact solution, equilibria, and isocline, adjust arrow density and length, and keep or clear solution curves. Reset All restores the starting state.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Drag the initial point on the graph, or choose an equation and explore the slope field.
